title: Ley Constitucional que crea el Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios
summary: Annual tax of 0.25% to 1.5% on the net wealth of individuals and companies classed as special taxpayers (threshold 150 million tax units after the reprint); in application since 2019.
status: Published in Gaceta Oficial 41.667 on 3 July 2019 and reprinted in Gaceta 41.696 on 16 August 2019; in force: the Seniat opened the filing period on 2 October 2024

title: El impuesto a los grandes patrimonios en Venezuela
summary: Legal commentary on the 2019 law (taxable event, rate, valuation, residence, exemptions) that also questions the competence of the Constituent Assembly to create it.
